_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with NVIDIA's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (NVDA listed 1999-01-22)

pit_profile.why: 'NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computational problems.' 'The market for our products is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change and evolving industry standards.' Its current competitors include 'suppliers and licensors of hardware and software for discrete and integrated GPUs, custom chips and other accelerated computing solutions, including solutions offered for AI, such as Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., or AMD, and Intel Corporation, or Intel' and 'large cloud services companies with internal teams designing chips and software that incorporate accelerated or AI computing functionality as part of their internal solutions or platforms, such as Alibaba Group, Alphabet Inc., Amazon, Inc., and Baidu, Inc.' (FY2023 10-K); CYCLICAL kept although the 10-K no longer calls the business cyclical (the BKR FY2015 rule; the class label only); the 10-K names AI as the field NVIDIA builds platforms for, a market it serves rather than a substitute for its products, so no theme in taxonomy_eras.json applies (the FY2013 10-K's cloud reading), and chips designed in-house by large cloud and internet companies, like GPUs integrated into other processors, stay here (the PEP obesity rule); GENAI, live from 2022-11-30, is scoped to AI substituting software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content and mobility: the 10-K names AI as NVIDIA's own market and offering ('Issues relating to the responsible use of our technologies, including AI in our offerings, may result in reputational and financial harm and liability.'), never as a substitute for its products, so it stays off the watch list (the AVGO reading)

BEAR.desc: EPS -54.8%/yr (worst year FY14-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +229.9%/yr (Q4 FY24 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +229.9%/yr (FY14-FY23 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +229.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NVDA (retrospective, 2024-01-05) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.57x (98.7% downside to Bear $6.19 / +172.0% upside to Bull $1335.27) | Adj composite 3.50 vs market 1.80: gap +1.70 [UNDERVALUED] | +1385% above the EPP floor $33.06 (19x FY24E $1.74) | Conservative 2-yr case: +41.1% total (+20.5%/yr) | At 282.2x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $649.31 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +205.5% YoY in Q3 FY24, forward revenues +223.9-237.1% (Q4 FY24 revenue guide (Q3 FY24 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
